The MailerLite REST API provides endpoints for managing subscribers, groups, segments, fields, campaigns, automations, forms, and webhooks. Authentication uses a Bearer token generated in the dashboard under Integrations > MailerLite API. All requests use JSON; rate-limited to 120 requests per minute per account.
